packageRules.description: sherpa-onnx-sys 1.13.5 fails to link on macOS ('could not find native static library sherpa-onnx-c-api'), breaking the default-features build that the macOS CI leg and macOS releases use. Linux is unaffected because it builds --no-default-features and excludes Parakeet, so Linux CI cannot catch a regression here. Hold at the last known-good 1.13.2 until #149 is resolved; remove this rule in the same commit that fixes it.
